description: Export a curated GitHub source tree. Keep current core regression tests and exclude historical release-only tests, duplicate fixtures and maintenance-only tools. Local authoring tests are not deleted. Release notes and bilingual commit summaries belong beside ZIP/MSI, never in source exports.

important_coverage: installer launch, upgrade, folder picker and completion rendering
v1.1.0 scoped UI state, selected profile snapshots, solid menus and close progress
test_policy.review_rule: Add new tests only for active important behavior; remove superseded fixtures together with their runner scripts after dependency and regression verification.

release_changes.commit_title: Add English localization and refine dark dialogs and profile editing
release_changes.commit_title_zh: 新增完整英语界面并适配暗色确认弹窗与配置编辑

changes.change: Advance the application identity to v1.1.2.
changes.change_zh: 将应用版本标识升级为 v1.1.2。

changes.change: Publish v1.1.2 while preserving upgrades and same-version reinstall support.
changes.change_zh: 发布 v1.1.2 安装程序并保留覆盖升级及同版本重新安装支持。

changes.change: Include active v1.1.2 regression coverage and bilingual top-level commit summaries.
changes.change_zh: 纳入 v1.1.2 当前回归测试并更新中英双语一级修改摘要。

changes.change: Add complete English presentation, light/dark opaque confirmation palettes, live tray/all-process candidates in profile editors, a compact language selector, aligned restore actions, silent-start labeling, and background opacity up to 90 percent.
changes.change_zh: 新增完整英语界面、适配深浅色的纯色确认弹窗、配置编辑器托盘及全部进程候选、紧凑语言框、恢复工具栏对齐、静默启动命名和最高 90% 背景图片不透明度。

changes.change: Verify English coverage and language switching, dark confirmation contrast, candidate preservation, restore layout, silent-start persistence and background opacity boundaries.
changes.change_zh: 验证英语词条覆盖及语言切换、暗色确认弹窗对比度、程序候选保留、恢复布局、静默启动持久化与背景不透明度边界。
